description:
Carry node ids through the dependency graph as the node's own typed id, so issue ids stay `IssueId` across every graph operation.

## Background

`GraphNode` (`crates/jit/src/graph/mod.rs`) exposes `fn id(&self) -> &str`, and `DependencyGraph` takes and returns string ids: `validate_add_dependency(from_id: &str, to_id: &str)`, `get_dependents(node_id: &str)`, `get_transitive_dependents`, `get_transitive_dependencies`, `compute_transitive_reduction` and `GraphError::NodeNotFound { id: String }`. Callers convert with `as_str()` at each call. Implementors are `Issue`, the template-expansion prospective node (`crates/jit/src/commands/template_expand.rs`), the hierarchy edge view and test fixtures. `HierarchyNode` already declares an associated `Id` type, the form to converge on (`@/inv/convention-convergence`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `GraphNode` declares an associated id type, and `Issue`'s is `IssueId`.
- [hard] REQ-02: `DependencyGraph` methods take and return that id type, and graph errors carry it, so no production caller converts an issue id to a string to call the graph.
- [hard] REQ-03: Across `crates/`, no production code outside CLI argument structs, server extractors, serde impls and rendering holds an issue id, gate key or gate-run id as a raw string, with each remaining site listed and justified in the change's report.
- [hard] REQ-04: Graph property tests still run over non-UUID fixture ids, and CLI and server JSON is unchanged.
title: The dependency graph carries typed node ids
